title: Chinese state group developing automated attack tool for cyber espionage, Google says
content_md: Google released its latest AI Threat Tracker report on Monday, writing that threat actors are rapidly evolving their use of artificial intelligence in attacks — now leaning more heavily on autonomous multi-agent offensive frameworks like Artex, CAIRN, CyberStrikeAI and PentAGI to execute multi-stage intrusions at greater operational velocity.
